images.description: Named QA bundle: literal loopback fixture preview before installation. This is the initial state of the new journey, not a screenshot of the previous release.

Actual marketplace installation keeps one sheet open and hands off the exact collision-safe mcp-setup-qa-2 receipt to existing connection controls. The fixture correctly reports Needs sign-in; authentication has not started automatically.

Explicit Sign In completes the production OAuth client against the local DCR/PKCE/resource/code-exchange fixture. The actual UI reports one responding tool. No real integration account or customer credential was used.
Actual named QA app at the supported 200% text size. Exact installed identity wraps and the connection actions remain available; larger content uses the native scroll view.

Native accessibility Scroll Down reaches the remaining 200% setup content and Remove action. Escape closes the sheet without removing its configuration. The QA-only text preference was restored afterward.
